expected_issues.title: Protected extension method signature changed without keeping the old overload
expected_issues.description:
The signature of the protected extension point _constructStdTypeResolverBuilder is changed in place, breaking subclasses that override the old 3-argument method.

TypeResolverProvider is designed to be subclassed (jackson-dataformat-xml overrides this method). Replacing the 3-argument protected method by a 4-argument one means existing overrides silently stop being called (or fail to compile with @Override), in a minor release. The old signature should be kept as a deprecated overload delegating to the new one.

annotator_notes: Upstream change https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/commit/590acf6d262d65b39b88604b8bed5f3473acf30f. Primary issue confirmed by the later upstream fix https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/commit/e7a0198e6a37d3a0022d5ec1707189ac62cd9232; its regression test reproduces the problem on this head.
